source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 January 1929, p. 12 ("Many Urban Candidates"); Belfast News-Letter, 8 January 1929, p. 10 ("Nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Nomination list: 'Mr. R. J. Beckett (Castle Ward)' among the unopposed nominations of retiring members.

note: Annual election of the Newtownards Urban Council, January 1929. All five wards were uncontested: the retiring members were returned unopposed, and in Scrabo Ward C. J. Stewart withdrew, giving Isaac Baxter an unopposed return. Returned unopposed.
